name: Mazchna
notes: Temporarily replaced by Achtryn during the events of While Guthix Sleeps.
Base points were raised from 2 to 6 in the Summer Sweep Up update (27 August 2025).
Combat level requirement can be bypassed by showing a Slayer cape (99 Slayer).
Tasks are relatively easy and short; located north-east of Canifis.
